build_SO2_Convolution: build an SO(2) convolution module for all m orders with optional radial function and extra m0 gating channels
build_SO2_Linear: build an SO(2) linear layer for all m orders with optional radial function and coefficient mapping
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build an SO(2) convolution with block-diagonal GEMM for faster tensor core utilization on m greater than 0
refactor_SO2_Convolution_to_block: refactor an SO2_Convolution to use SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock or SO2_Conv2_InternalBlock for block-diagonal GEMM performance
review_SO2_m_Conv: review the SO2_m_Conv class and its forward pass that performs SO(2) convolution on real and imaginary features
